name: Blast radius of a service
question: If this service fails, which services depend on it, what runs it, and which alerts fired on it?
claim: What the graph records as depending on the service, directly or through other services. It is a dependency in the data, not a measurement of impact: a caller with a fallback still appears, and a dependency nobody recorded does not.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: The service that fails: its khonsu_id.

parameters.name: hops
parameters.description: How many DEPENDS_ON steps to follow back.

steps.title: Services that depend on it, directly or through others
assumptions: Every DEPENDS_ON relationship is a hard dependency: the data does not say which callers degrade and which fail.

steps.title: What runs the service
steps.cypher: MATCH (h)-[r:RUNS]->(s {khonsu_id: $service}) RETURN h AS host, r AS runs ORDER BY h.khonsu_id

steps.title: Alerts that fired on the service or on what runs it
steps.cypher: MATCH (a:Alert)-[f:FIRED_ON]->(t) WHERE t.khonsu_id = $service OR (t)-[:RUNS]->({khonsu_id: $service}) RETURN a AS alert, f AS fired_on, t.khonsu_id AS target ORDER BY a.khonsu_id
